correctness.rationale: The cited 2026 toric-Richardson and magic-word results identify this explicit smooth projective Bott fourfold and its 4-cube face graph. The 24-permutation Bruhat-rank enumeration is exhaustive; each vertex has four distinct root tangent characters. For every one of 32 edges the difference of c1 restrictions equals 0, 2 or 4 times the primitive edge character, with histogram (4,24,4). Nonnegative invariant-curve degrees imply nefness by the toric Mori cone; a zero degree precludes ampleness. The exact Atiyah–Bott localization sum is 320 under four cocharacters, proving bigness. The standalone verifier is checked from its actual packaged bytes. Limits: the full exceptional locus and image singularities are not classified.

A natural finite complete classification of anticanonical degrees is reusable for studying its contraction and neighboring Bott varieties.
